title: iHRIS use-case model (2009): glossary
description: The glossary terms of the four 2009 iHRIS use-case reports (Common, Manage, Qualify, Plan), verbatim. The reports' document summary names a glossary (Subject: “Use cases, actor goal list, glossary and packages”), but no report holds a glossary section, so this scheme has no terms. None is invented. iHRIS Common use cases (7/13/2009): no glossary section. iHRIS Manage use cases (7/13/2009): no glossary section. iHRIS Qualify use cases (3/25/2009): no glossary section. iHRIS Plan use cases (3/25/2009): no glossary section.
source: From the iHRIS use-case model by IntraHealth International / the Capacity Project iHRIS team (2009), published with permission. uploads/ihris-use-cases/manifest.json
